name: Dr. Mohamed Khalil
title: Senior Critical Care Intensivist
summary: 20+ years of high-acuity intensive care across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Egypt. ECMO, CRRT, mechanical ventilation and critical care ultrasound.
bio: Senior Critical Care Intensivist at American Hospital Dubai, leading complex case management across general, surgical, cardiovascular and trauma intensive care.

Recognised for measurable improvements in survival and recovery through precision-driven interventions, rapid clinical decision-making and advanced life support. Proficient in haemodynamic monitoring, critical care ultrasound, airway management and invasive procedures.
Leads multidisciplinary teams, streamlines rapid response, and brings evidence-based practice to the bedside. MD candidate in Critical Care Medicine at Cairo University.
quote: Precision-driven. Evidence-based. Uncompromising in the pursuit of the best outcome for every patient.
